comment: Communities/districts along the Airport→Palisadoes→Kingston→Bog Walk→Linstead→Moneague→Faith's Pen→Fern Gully→Ocho Rios route. Recognition layer 2. lat/lon are map-derived; entries marked needs_owner_review:true should be verified against the owner's lived knowledge before release. Radius is in compressed world metres (route is scaled to ~30% of real distance).

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The iconic strip — sea on both sides, coconut trees, gateway to the island

communities.name: Port Royal
communities.note: Once the 'wickedest city in the world'; now a quiet fishing village at the peninsula tip

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston; the Harbour View roundabout marks where the Palisadoes meets the mainland

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial area along Windward Road; home to the Rockfort Mineral Baths

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital and largest city; seat of government, music, and culture

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Busy Kingston intersection — gateway between downtown and uptown

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Uptown Kingston's commercial hub; St. Andrew parish capital — named for a long-gone cotton tree

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Modern business district; hotels, offices, and the US Embassy

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former Spanish colonial capital of Jamaica; St. Catherine parish capital

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Historic single-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre — famous for flooding in heavy rain

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the mouth of the gorge; the road is cut through the mountains above the Rio Cobre

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town in St. Catherine; immortalised in the folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Cool hilltop crossroads; Moneague Lake nearby disappears in dry season

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival; every Jamaican knows this stop

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Lush canopy tunnel through the mountains — once a riverbed, now one of Jamaica's most scenic roads

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast resort town; home to Dunn's River Falls — end of the Airport Run
